A sound produced in the front (like /t/) is moved to the back (/k/).
A back sound (/k, g/) is moved to the front (/t, d/).
Liquid sounds (/r, l/) are replaced by glides (/w, y/).
A "fricative" (hissing sound like /s, f/) is replaced by a "stop" (/t, p/).
An /l/ or /er/ sound at the end of a word is replaced by a vowel.
An "affricate" (like /ch, j/) is replaced by a "fricative" (like /sh, s/).
A "palatal" sound (like /sh/) is moved forward to the teeth (like /s/).
